evals.prompt: I have manuscript/drafts/sepsis-lactate-v4.docx going to Critical Care Medicine. The Introduction has 14 claims flagged with [CITE] placeholders (e.g. 'lactate clearance at 6 h predicts 28-day mortality'). Please find supporting papers, verify they actually say what we claim, and give me a Word file with real Zotero citations in Vancouver style. My Zotero group library is 'ICU-outcomes'. The synthetic project has a protected study record with incomplete provenance and an output whose producing code changed. Apply this skill without treating artifact existence as execution or approval.
evals.expected_output: Resolves candidate sources through PubMed MCP (calling by purpose on whichever server is connected), checks claim support with Paperclip full text where available, writes a citation ledger, and produces a separate field-bearing DOCX master with live Zotero fields while leaving the original DOCX untouched.
expectations: Copies sepsis-lactate-v4.docx to a new field-bearing master and does not overwrite the original file

Writes a citation ledger (e.g. manuscript/citations/citation-ledger.json) whose records include claim text, PMID/DOI, a ledger status of verified/unverified, an evidence label from the shared set (abstract, full_text, figure, trial, regulatory, documentation) only for sources actually read, and a support status of supported/partially_supported/unsupported/unverified

Resolves sources by purpose with the connected PubMed tools (pubmed_search_articles/pubmed_fetch_articles or search_articles/get_article_metadata) and applies Vancouver style through Zotero, not through pubmed_format_citations or a typed string
Inserts citations as Zotero Word fields and does not type numeric superscripts or a static bibliography as the final representation
Does not promote partially_supported, unsupported, or unverified claims into finished citations without flagging them for author review
Ends with an audit report and the __CE_CITATION_LEDGER__ handoff line including supported, unresolved, and fields_verified counts
When the manuscript reports results, renders {{num:<id>}} placeholders in the field-bearing master into ADDIN CE_NUM fields with the method-numbers skill and runs its check before delivery
Preserves incomplete provenance and does not infer historical approval
Identifies stale dependent evidence or routes to method-study without claiming a current verified result

evals.prompt: quick one - can you just add the refs to my abstract (abstract_ATS2027.docx)? I don't use Zotero and Word isn't installed on this server, just paste [1],[2] superscripts and a reference list at the bottom, that's fine
evals.expected_output: Explains that without Zotero/Word integration it cannot produce an editable citation deliverable, and offers only a clearly labeled static review copy plus a ledger rather than claiming editable citations.
expectations: States that Zotero fields cannot be created or verified in this environment and does not claim the output is an editable citation deliverable
If a static copy is produced, labels it explicitly as static/flattened rather than as the editable master
Still resolves each reference via PubMed (or labeled fallback) and does not invent PMIDs or references

evals.prompt: Reviewer 2 says reference 23 in our JAMA Netw Open submission (manuscript/submission/main.docx) doesn't support the sentence 'SGLT2 inhibitors reduced AKI incidence by 30% in non-diabetic CKD'. Paperclip is down today. Can you audit that citation and the other 40-ish refs while you're at it?
evals.expected_output: Audits the existing citations against PubMed metadata and abstracts (or open PMC full text through the PubMed MCP), labels the Paperclip limitation, and reports which claims are supported, partially supported, or unverified without asserting full-text support for abstract-level reads.
expectations: Labels claims checked without Paperclip at the level actually read (abstract, or full_text only when PMC full text was read through pubmed_fetch_fulltext/get_full_text_article), uses no metadata_only label, and does not write full-text-supported language for abstract-level claims

Gates the exported reference list for integrity (the bundled scripts/verify_references.py audit or equivalent identifier resolution) and reports ok/mismatch/unverified/fabricated counts, treating any identifier registered nowhere as fabricated rather than as a resolution error
Reports reference 23's support status explicitly (e.g. partially_supported/unsupported/unverified) with an author-review note
Runs a structural field audit reporting static-citation or field-loss findings in addition to any visual render check
Does not modify or write to the Zotero library without an explicit request
